nnn - Supercharge your productivity!

`nnn` (_n³_) is a full-featured terminal file manager. It's tiny, nearly 0-config and incredibly fast. It is designed to be unobtrusive with smart workflows to match the trains of thought. `nnn` can analyze disk usage, batch rename, launch apps and pick files. The plugin repository has tons of plugins to extend the capabilities further e.g. live previews, (un)mount disks, find & list, file/dir diff, upload files. Runs on the Pi, Termux (Android), Linux, macOS, BSD, Haiku, Cygwin, WSL, across DEs or a strictly CLI env. ## Features - Quality - Privacy-aware (no unconfirmed user data collection) - POSIX-compliant - Highly optimized code - Frugal - Typically needs less than 3.5MB resident memory - Works with 8 colors (and xterm 256 colors) - Disk-IO sensitive (few disk reads and writes) - No FPU usage (all integer maths, even for file size) - Minimizes screen refresh with fast line redraws - Tiny binary (typically around 100KB) - 1-column mode for smaller terminals and form factors - Portable - Language-agnostic plugins - Static binary available (no need to install) - Minimal library deps, easy to compile - No config file, minimal config with sensible defaults - Plugin to backup configuration - Widely available on many packagers - Touch enabled, handheld-friendly shortcuts - Unicode support - Modes - Light (default), detail - Disk usage analyzer (block/apparent) - File picker - Navigation - Filter with automatic dir entry on unique match - *Type-to-nav* (turbo navigation/always filter) mode - Jump to an entry with visible relative offset - Contexts (_aka_ tabs/workspaces) with custom colors - Sessions, bookmarks, mark and visit a dir - Remote mounts (needs `sshfs`, `rclone`) - Familiar shortcuts (arrows, ~, -, @), quick look-up - `cd` on quit (*easy* shell integration) - Proceed to next file on file open and selection - Search - Instant filtering with *search-as-you-type* - Fuzzy, regex and string (default) filters - Subtree search plugin to open or edit files - Sort - Ordered pure numeric names by default (visit `/proc`) - Case-insensitive version (_aka_ natural) sort - By name, access/change/mod (default) time, size, extn - Reverse sort - Directory-specific ordering - Mimes - Preview hovered files in FIFO-based previewer - Open with desktop opener or specify a custom opener - File-specific colors (or minimal _dirs in context color_) - Icons and Emojis support (customize and compile-in) - Plugin for image, video and audio thumbnails - Create, list, extract (to), mount (FUSE based) archives - Option to open all text files in `$EDITOR` - Convenience - Detailed file stats and mime information - Run plugins and custom commands with hotkeys - FreeDesktop compliant trash utility integration - Cross-dir file/all/range selection - Create (with parents), rename, duplicate files and dirs - Create new file or directory (tree) on startup - Batch renamer for selection or dir - List input stream of file paths from stdin or plugin - Copy (as), move (as), delete, archive, link selection - Easily copy, move paths in system clipboard to current dir - Dir updates, notification on `cp`, `mv`, `rm` completion - Copy file paths to system clipboard on select - Launch apps, run commands, spawn a shell, toggle exe - Access context paths/files at prompt or spawned shell - Lock terminal after configurable idle timeout - Capture and show output of a program in help screen - Basic support for screen readers and braille displays ## Usage Don't memorize! Arrows, /, q suffice. Tab creates and/or cycles contexts. ? lists shortcuts. For detailed usage instructions, command-line options, and configuration information, please refer to the man page (`man nnn`) or visit the project Wiki. ## Installation `nnn` is available on many package managers. Install it using your distribution's package manager, or download a pre-built static binary. Common installation methods: - **Arch Linux**: `pacman -S nnn` - **Debian/Ubuntu**: `apt install nnn` - **Fedora**: `dnf install nnn` - **macOS (Homebrew)**: `brew install nnn` - **FreeBSD**: `pkg install nnn` For more installation options and detailed instructions, visit the project Wiki. ## License BSD 2-Clause License Copyright © 2016-2026 Arun Prakash Jana and contributors See LICENSE file for full license text. --- MANUAL --- .Dd Feb 14, 2026 .Dt NNN 1 .Os .Sh NAME .Nm nnn .Nd The unorthodox terminal file manager. .Sh SYNOPSIS .Nm .Op Ar -aAcCdDeEfgHJKnQrRSuUVxz0h .Op Ar -b key .Op Ar -F val .Op Ar -l val .Op Ar -p file .Op Ar -P key .Op Ar -s name .Op Ar -t secs .Op Ar -T key .Op Ar PATH .Sh DESCRIPTION .Nm .Pq Nnn's Not Noice is a performance-optimized, feature-packed terminal file manager with seamless desktop integration, simplified navigation, .Em type-to-nav mode with dir auto-enter, disk usage analyzer mode, bookmarks, contexts, application launcher, familiar navigation shortcuts, subshell spawning and much more. It remains a simple and efficient file manager that stays out of your way. .Pp .Nm opens the current working directory if .Ar PATH is not specified. If .Ar PATH is specified and it exists, .Nm will open it. If the .Ar PATH doesn't exist and ends with a \fB/\fR, .Nm will attempt to create the directory tree and open it. Otherwise, .Ar PATH is considered a path to a regular file and .Nm attempts to create the complete directory tree to the file, open the parent directory and prompt to create the new file in it with the base filename. .Sh OPTIONS For detailed command-line options and flags, please refer to the full documentation or run .Nm with the .Fl h flag to see available options. .Sh SEE ALSO For more information, visit the project homepage or Wiki. .Sh AUTHORS .An Arun Prakash Jana Aq Mt engineerarun@gmail.com .Pp and contributors. --- LICENSE --- BSD 2-Clause License Copyright (c) 2014-2016, Lazaros Koromilas Copyright (c) 2014-2016, Dimitris Papastamos Copyright (c) 2016-2026, Arun Prakash Jana All rights reserved. content.text: The executable is a curses-based file manager. I’ve mapped its CLI options, screen layout, navigation, filtering, selection output, and common file-operation prompts. I’ll now implement those behaviors in an independent Python codebase, then compare it against the reference in tmux.

#!/bin/sh
set -eu
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
# The implementation uses only Python's standard library, including curses.
# No network access or third-party packages are required.
command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'python3 is required' >&2; exit 1; }
python3 -c 'import curses, pathlib, subprocess, termios'
cp main.py executable
chmod 755 executable
EOF

cat > main.py <<'PY'
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""An independent terminal file manager, implemented from CLI observations."""
import os
import sys
import re
import stat
import time
import locale
import curses
import signal
import errno
import pwd
import grp
import shutil
import shlex
import json
import subprocess
import tempfile
import termios
import unicodedata
import functools

HELP = """usage: nnn [OPTIONS] [PATH]

The unorthodox terminal file manager.

positional args:
  PATH   start dir/file [default: .]

optional args:
 -a      auto NNN_FIFO
 -A      no dir auto-enter during filter
 -b key  open bookmark key (trumps -s/S)
 -B      use bsdtar for archives
 -c      cli-only NNN_OPENER (trumps -e)
 -C      8-color scheme
 -d      detail mode
 -D      dirs in context color
 -e      text in $VISUAL/$EDITOR/vi
 -E      internal edits in EDITOR
 -f      use history file
 -F val  fifo mode [0:preview 1:explore]
 -g      regex filters
 -H      show hidden files
 -i      show current file info
 -J      no auto-advance on selection
 -K      detect key collision and exit
 -l val  set scroll lines
 -n      type-to-nav mode
 -N      use native prompt
 -o      open files only on Enter
 -p file selection file [-:stdout]
 -P key  run plugin key
 -Q      no quit confirmation
 -r      use advcpmv patched cp, mv
 -R      no rollover at edges
 -s name load session by name
 -S      persistent session
 -t secs timeout to lock
 -T key  sort order [a/d/e/r/s/t/v]
 -u      use selection (no prompt)
 -U      show user and group
 -V      show version
 -x      notis, selection sync, xterm title
 -z      in order fuzzy filters
 -0      null separator in picker mode
 -h      show help

v5.2
BSD 2-Clause
https://github.com/jarun/nnn
"""
KEYHELP = r"""  |V\_
  /. \\
 (;^; ||
   /___3
  (___n))

 NAVIGATION
         Up k  Prev              PgUp ^U  Page up
         Dn j  Next              PgDn ^D  Page down
         Lt h  Parent            ~ ` @ -  ~, /, start, prev
     Ret Rt l  Open                    '  First file/match
         g ^A  Top                     J  Jump to entry/offset
         G ^E  End                    ^J  Toggle auto-advance on open
        B (,)  Book(mark)           b ^/  Select bookmark
          1-4  Context           (Sh)Tab  Cycle/new context
      2Esc ^Q  Quit                   ^y  Next young
           ^G  QuitCD                  Q  Pick/err, quit
            q  Quit context

 FILTER & PROMPT
            /  Filter                 ^N  Toggle type-to-nav
          Esc  Exit prompt            ^L  Toggle last filter
            .  Toggle hidden     Alt+Esc  Unfilter, quit context

 FILES
         o ^O  Open with               n  Create new/link
         f ^F  File stats              d  Detail mode toggle
           ^R  Rename/dup              r  Batch rename
            z  Archive                 e  Edit file
            *  Toggle exe              >  Export list
      Space +  (Un)select            m-m  Select range/clear
            a  Select all              A  Invert sel
         p ^P  Copy here            w ^W  Cp/mv sel as
         v ^V  Move here               E  Edit sel list
         x ^X  Delete or trash         S  Listed sel size
            X  Delete (rm -rf)       Esc  Send to FIFO

 MISC
        Alt ;  Select plugin           =  Launch app
         ! ^]  Shell                   ]  Cmd prompt
            c  Connect remote          u  Unmount remote/archive
         t ^T  Sort toggles            s  Manage session
            T  Set time type           0  Lock
           ^L  Redraw                  ?  Help, conf
"""


def atoi(value):
    m = re.match(r'^[ \t]*([+-]?\d+)', str(value))
    return int(m.group(1)) if m else 0


def options(argv):
    flags = set()
    values = {}
    paths = []
    valid = 'aAbBcCdDeEfFgHiJJKlNnoOpPQrRsStTuUVxz0h'
    valid = 'aAbBcCdDeEfFgHiJKlNnopPQrRsStTuUVxz0h'
    argopts = 'bFlpPstT'
    valid += 'HS'
    # Environment options are individual letters, not shell words.
    def apply(c, value=None, env=False):
        if c not in valid:
            if not env:
                sys.stderr.write(f"{argv[0]}: invalid option -- '{c}'\n")
            sys.stdout.write(HELP)
            raise SystemExit(1)
        if c == 'h':
            sys.stdout.write(HELP)
            raise SystemExit(0)
        if c == 'V':
            print('5.2')
            raise SystemExit(0)
        if c == 'K':
            raise SystemExit(0)
        if c in argopts:
            if value is not None:
                values[c] = value
        else:
            flags.add(c)
    for c in os.environ.get('NNN_OPTS', ''):
        apply(c, env=True)
    i = 1
    stop = False
    while i < len(argv):
        word = argv[i]
        if word == '--' and not stop:
            stop = True
        elif word.startswith('-') and len(word) > 1 and not stop:
            j = 1
            while j < len(word):
                c = word[j]
                value = None
                if c in argopts:
                    if j + 1 < len(word):
                        value = word[j+1:]
                        j = len(word)
                    elif i + 1 < len(argv):
                        i += 1
                        value = argv[i]
                    else:
                        sys.stderr.write(f"{argv[0]}: option requires an argument -- '{c}'\n")
                        sys.stdout.write(HELP)
                        raise SystemExit(1)
                    apply(c, value)
                    break
                apply(c)
                j += 1
        else:
            paths.append(word)
        i += 1
    if atoi(values.get('F', '0')) not in (0, 1):
        raise SystemExit(1)
    return flags, values, paths


def human(size):
    size = max(0, int(size))
    if size < 1024:
        return str(size) + 'B'
    unit = 0
    scale = 1
    while size >= scale * 1024 and unit < 5:
        unit += 1
        scale *= 1024
    # Display up to three decimal places, without insignificant zeroes.
    fraction = (size % scale) * 1000 // scale
    tail = ('.' + str(fraction).zfill(3).rstrip('0')) if fraction else ''
    return str(size // scale) + tail + 'BKM GTP'.replace(' ', '')[unit]


def width(s):
    total = 0
    for c in s:
        if unicodedata.combining(c):
            continue
        total += 2 if unicodedata.east_asian_width(c) in ('W', 'F') else 1
    return total


def clip(s, n):
    out = ''
    used = 0
    for c in s:
        w = 0 if unicodedata.combining(c) else (2 if unicodedata.east_asian_width(c) in ('W', 'F') else 1)
        if used + w > n:
            break
        out += c
        used += w
    return out


def printable(s):
    return ''.join(c if c.isprintable() else '?' for c in s)


def fileext(name):
    pos = name.rfind('.')
    return name[pos:] if pos >= 0 else ''


def read_map(var):
    data = os.environ.get(var, '')
    mapping = {}
    if not data:
        return mapping
    for pair in data.split(';'):
        if not pair:
            continue
        if len(pair) < 3 or pair[1] != ':':
            sys.stderr.write(var + '\n')
            raise SystemExit(1)
        mapping[pair[0]] = pair[2:]
    return mapping


class Entry:
    def __init__(self, path, name, du=False):
        self.name = name
        self.path = os.path.join(path, name)
        self.lstat = os.lstat(self.path)
        self.link = stat.S_ISLNK(self.lstat.st_mode)
        self.broken = False
        try:
            self.stat = os.stat(self.path) if self.link else self.lstat
        except OSError:
            self.stat = self.lstat
            self.broken = True
        self.directory = stat.S_ISDIR(self.stat.st_mode)
        self.mode = self.lstat.st_mode if du and self.link else self.stat.st_mode
        self.size = self.stat.st_size if stat.S_ISREG(self.stat.st_mode) and not self.link else 0
        self.du = 0
        self.files = 1
        if self.directory:
            self.suffix = '/'
        elif self.link:
            self.suffix = '@'
        elif stat.S_ISFIFO(self.mode):
            self.suffix = '|'
        elif stat.S_ISSOCK(self.mode):
            self.suffix = '='
        elif stat.S_ISREG(self.mode) and self.mode & 0o111:
            self.suffix = '*'
        else:
            self.suffix = ''


class Context:
    def __init__(self, path, flags):
        self.path = path
        self.prev = ''
        self.index = 0
        self.top = 0
        self.hidden = 'H' in flags
        self.detail = 'd' in flags
        self.sort = ''
        self.reverse = False
        self.version = False
        self.time_type = 'm'
        self.filters = []
        self.lastfilters = []
        self.name = ''
        self.du = ''


class Manager:
    def __init__(self, flags, values, paths):
        self.flags = flags
        self.values = values
        self.home = os.path.abspath(os.environ.get('HOME') or os.path.expanduser('~'))
        self.config = os.path.join(os.environ.get('XDG_CONFIG_HOME') or os.path.join(self.home, '.config'), 'nnn')
        self.bms = read_map('NNN_BMS')
        self.plugins = read_map('NNN_PLUG')
        self.selection_file = os.path.join(self.config, '.selection')
        self.picker = values.get('p')
        self.picker_out = None
        self.selected = []
        self.range_start = None
        self.noadvance = 'J' in flags
        self.advance_open = False
        self.navi = 'n' in flags
        self.filter_mode = 'reg' if 'g' in flags else 'fzy' if 'z' in flags else 'str'
        self.ignorecase = True
        self.filter_edit = False
        self.filter_text = ''
        self.filter_base = []
        self.entries = []
        self.all_entries = []
        self.prompt = None
        self.message = None
        self.jump = False
        self.overlay = None
        self.running = True
        self.result = 0
        self.lastesc = 0
        self.sort_disk_total = 0
        self.sort_disk_count = 0
        self.current = 0
        self.colors = {}
        self.ctxcolors = []
        self.last_scan = 0
        self.start_new = None
        self.pending_plugin = values.get('P')
        self.write_cd = bool(os.environ.get('NNN_TMPFILE'))
        self.pipe_paths = None
        try:
            self.cwd = os.getcwd()
        except OSError:
            self.cwd = self.home
        self.start_path = self.cwd
        path = paths[0] if paths else self.cwd
        path = os.path.abspath(os.path.expanduser(path))
        initial_name = ''
        if os.path.isdir(path):
            path = os.path.realpath(path)
        elif os.path.lexists(path):
            initial_name = os.path.basename(path)
            path = os.path.realpath(os.path.dirname(path))
        else:
            if paths and paths[0].endswith('/'):
                try:
                    os.makedirs(path, exist_ok=True)
                except OSError as e:
                    self.start_error = e.strerror
                    path = self.cwd
            else:
                initial_name = os.path.basename(path)
                self.start_new = initial_name
                path = os.path.dirname(path)
                try:
                    os.makedirs(path, exist_ok=True)
                except OSError as e:
                    self.start_error = e.strerror
                    path = self.cwd
        key = values.get('b')
        if key and len(key) == 1:
            if key not in self.bms:
                sys.stderr.write('invalid key\n')
                raise SystemExit(1)
            path = os.path.realpath(os.path.expanduser(self.bms[key]))
            initial_name = ''
            if not os.path.isdir(path):
                sys.stderr.write('chdir failed\n')
                raise SystemExit(1)
        self.start_path = path
        for sub in ('', 'bookmarks', 'sessions', 'mounts', 'plugins'):
            try:
                os.makedirs(os.path.join(self.config, sub), mode=0o755, exist_ok=True)
            except OSError as e:
                sys.stderr.write('mkdir failed\n')
                raise SystemExit(1)
        self.contexts = [None] * 8
        self.contexts[0] = Context(path, flags)
        self.ctx.name = initial_name
        self.overlay_offset = 0
        self.overlay_x = 0
        self.external_screen = False
        if values.get('T'):
            self.sorting(values['T'][0], reload=False)
        sess = values.get('s') or ('@' if 'S' in flags else None)
        if sess and not key:
            self.load_session(sess, startup=True)
        try:
            os.chdir(self.ctx.path)
        except OSError:
            pass

    @property
    def ctx(self):
        return self.contexts[self.current]

    def attr(self, color):
        if color not in self.colors:
            try:
                n = len(self.colors) + 1
                curses.init_pair(n, color if color < curses.COLORS else color % 8, -1)
                self.colors[color] = curses.color_pair(n)
            except curses.error:
                self.colors[color] = 0
        return self.colors[color]

    def current_color(self):
        return self.ctxcolors[self.current] if self.ctxcolors else self.attr(4)

    def load_colors(self):
        spec = os.environ.get('NNN_COLORS', '44444444')
        if spec.startswith('#') and len(spec) >= 17:
            nums = []
            for i in range(1, 17, 2):
                try: nums.append(int(spec[i:i+2], 16))
                except ValueError: nums.append(4)
        else:
            nums = []
            for c in spec[:8]:
                try: nums.append(int(c, 16))
                except ValueError: nums.append(4)
        nums = (nums + [4]*8)[:8]
        self.ctxcolors = [self.attr(c) for c in nums]

    def scan(self, keep=True, name=None):
        c = self.ctx
        oldname = name if name is not None else (self.entry().name if keep and self.entry() else c.name)
        entries = []
        try:
            names = os.listdir(c.path)
        except OSError as e:
            names = []
            self.message = e.strerror
        for n in names:
            if n.startswith('.') and not c.hidden:
                continue
            try:
                ent = Entry(c.path, n, bool(c.du))
                if c.du:
                    ent.du, ent.files = self.disk_usage(ent.path, c.du == 'a')
                entries.append(ent)
            except OSError:
                continue
        entries.sort(key=functools.cmp_to_key(self.compare))
        self.all_entries = entries
        self.entries = self.apply_filters(entries, c.filters)
        if self.filter_edit:
            self.entries = self.apply_filters(self.entries, [(self.filter_text, self.filter_mode, self.ignorecase)])
        if oldname:
            for i, e in enumerate(self.entries):
                if e.name == oldname:
                    c.index = i
                    break
            else:
                c.index = min(c.index, len(self.entries)-1)
        c.index = max(0, min(c.index, len(self.entries)-1))
        c.name = self.entry().name if self.entry() else ''
        if c.du:
            # The totals include hidden files even when they aren't listed.
            total, count = self.disk_usage(c.path, c.du == 'a')
            try:
                st = os.lstat(c.path)
                total -= st.st_size if c.du == 'a' else st.st_blocks*512
            except OSError:
                pass
            self.sort_disk_total, self.sort_disk_count = total, count
        self.adjust_top()
        self.last_scan = time.monotonic()
        try: self.dir_stamp = os.stat(c.path).st_mtime_ns
        except OSError: self.dir_stamp = 0

    def disk_usage(self, path, apparent):
        try:
            st = os.lstat(path)
        except OSError:
            return 0, 0
        size = st.st_size if apparent else st.st_blocks * 512
        count = 1
        if stat.S_ISDIR(st.st_mode):
            try:
                for n in os.listdir(path):
                    s, cnt = self.disk_usage(os.path.join(path, n), apparent)
                    size += s
                    count += cnt
            except OSError:
                pass
        return size, count

    def compare_names(self, a, b):
        if self.ctx.version:
            def natural(x):
                return [(1,int(p),len(p)) if p.isdigit() else (0,p.casefold()) for p in re.split('(\d+)', x)]
            x, y = natural(a), natural(b)
            res = (x > y) - (x < y)
            return res or ((a > b) - (a < b))
        if a.isascii() and b.isascii() and a.isdecimal() and b.isdecimal():
            x,y = int(a),int(b)
            if x != y:
                return (x > y) - (x < y)
        return (a > b) - (a < b)

    def timestamp(self, entry):
        st = entry.lstat if self.ctx.du and entry.link else entry.stat
        return getattr(st, {'a':'st_atime','c':'st_ctime','m':'st_mtime'}[self.ctx.time_type])

    def compare(self, a, b):
        c = self.ctx
        if a.directory != b.directory:
            return -1 if a.directory else 1
        result = 0
        if c.du:
            result = (b.du > a.du) - (b.du < a.du)
        elif c.sort == 's' and not a.directory:
            result = (b.size > a.size) - (b.size < a.size)
        elif c.sort == 't':
            x, y = int(self.timestamp(a)), int(self.timestamp(b))
            result = (y > x) - (y < x)
        elif c.sort == 'e' and not a.directory:
            x,y = fileext(a.name),fileext(b.name)
            if c.version: x,y = x.casefold(),y.casefold()
            result = (x > y) - (x < y)
        if result == 0:
            result = self.compare_names(a.name, b.name)
        return -result if c.reverse else result

    def apply_filters(self, entries, filters):
        for text, mode, ic in filters:
            if not text:
                continue
            if mode == 'reg':
                try:
                    reg = re.compile(text, re.I if ic else 0)
                    entries = [e for e in entries if reg.search(e.name)]
                except re.error:
                    entries = []
            elif mode == 'fzy':
                def match(e):
                    hay = iter(e.name.casefold() if ic else e.name)
                    return all(any(c == v for c in hay) for v in (text.casefold() if ic else text))
                entries = [e for e in entries if match(e)]
            else:
                text = text.casefold() if ic else text
                entries = [e for e in entries if text in (e.name.casefold() if ic else e.name)]
        return entries

    def entry(self):
        return self.entries[self.ctx.index] if self.entries and self.ctx.index < len(self.entries) else None

    def adjust_top(self):
        c = self.ctx
        page = max(1, getattr(self, 'rows', 24) - 4)
        c.top = max(0, min(c.top, len(self.entries)-page))
        if c.index < c.top:
            c.top = c.index
        if c.index >= c.top + page:
            c.top = c.index-page+1

    def put(self, y, x, s, attr=0):
        if x >= self.cols or y >= self.rows or y < 0:
            return
        if x < 0:
            s = s[-x:]
            x = 0
        try:
            self.win.addstr(y,x,clip(s,self.cols-x),attr)
        except (curses.error, UnicodeError):
            pass

    def shown_path(self):
        p = self.ctx.path
        if p == self.home:
            p = '~'
        elif p.startswith(self.home + '/'):
            p = '~' + p[len(self.home):]
        available = self.cols - 16
        if width(p) > available:
            bits = p.split('/')
            for i in range(len(bits)-1):
                if bits[i] and bits[i] != '~':
                    bits[i] = bits[i][0]
            p = '/'.join(bits)
        return clip(p, available)

    def entry_attr(self, e, active):
        minimal = 'C' in self.flags or curses.COLORS < 256
        if minimal:
            a = self.current_color() if e.directory else curses.A_DIM if e.link else 0
        elif e.link:
            a = self.attr(198 if e.broken else 51)
        elif e.directory:
            a = 0 if 'D' in self.flags else self.attr(39)
        elif stat.S_ISFIFO(e.mode) or stat.S_ISSOCK(e.mode) or stat.S_ISBLK(e.mode) or stat.S_ISCHR(e.mode):
            a = self.attr(214)
        elif e.mode & 0o111:
            a = self.attr(46)
        elif e.stat.st_size == 0:
            a = self.attr(196)
        else:
            a = 0
        if e.directory and not minimal:
            a |= curses.A_BOLD
        if active:
            a |= curses.A_REVERSE | curses.A_BOLD
        return a

    def status_parts(self):
        c = self.ctx
        e = self.entry()
        if not e:
            return [('0/0',False)]
        count = f'{c.index+1}/{len(self.entries)}'
        if c.du:
            avail = os.statvfs(c.path)
            msg = f'{count} {c.du}u:{human(self.sort_disk_total)} avail:{human(avail.f_bavail*avail.f_frsize)} files:{self.sort_disk_count} {human(e.du)}'
            return [(msg,False)]
        flags = ('H' if c.hidden else '') + ('R' if c.reverse else '')
        flags += {'s':'S', 't':c.time_type.upper(), 'e':'E'}.get(c.sort,'')
        flags += 'V' if c.version else ''
        prefix = count + ' ' + flags + ' '
        if self.range_start is not None:
            prefix += '*   '
        elif self.selected:
            prefix += f'+{len(self.selected)}   '
        date = time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M', time.localtime(self.timestamp(e)))
        modes = stat.filemode(e.mode)
        if e.link:
            modes = 'l' + modes[1:]
        user = ''
        if 'U' in self.flags:
            try: uid = pwd.getpwuid(e.stat.st_uid).pw_name
            except KeyError: uid = str(e.stat.st_uid)
            try: gid = grp.getgrgid(e.stat.st_gid).gr_name
            except KeyError: gid = str(e.stat.st_gid)
            user = f' {uid}:{gid}'
        size = human(e.lstat.st_size if e.link else e.stat.st_size)
        rest = ' ' + modes + user + ' ' + size
        if e.link:
            try: rest += ' ->' + os.readlink(e.path)
            except OSError: pass
        elif not e.directory:
            rest += (' ' + fileext(e.name)) if fileext(e.name) else ''
        return [(prefix,False),(date,True),(rest,False)]

    def draw(self):
        self.rows,self.cols = self.win.getmaxyx()
        self.adjust_top()
        self.win.erase()
        c = self.ctx
        color = self.current_color()
        for i in range(8):
            a = (self.ctxcolors[i] | curses.A_BOLD | (curses.A_REVERSE if i == self.current else curses.A_UNDERLINE)) if self.contexts[i] else 0
            self.put(0, i*2, str(i+1), a)
        self.put(0,16,self.shown_path(),color | curses.A_UNDERLINE)
        if c.top:
            self.put(1,0,'^')
        page = max(1,self.rows-4)
        detail = c.detail and self.cols >= 40
        for index in range(c.top,min(len(self.entries),c.top+page)):
            e = self.entries[index]
            row = index-c.top+2
            active = index == c.index
            selected = e.path in self.selected
            cursor = 1
            if self.jump:
                offset = index - c.index
                offstr = '0' if offset == 0 else f'{offset:+d}'
                self.put(row,1,offstr.rjust(3)+' ')
                cursor = 5
            elif detail:
                self.put(row,0,'>' if active else ' ',curses.A_BOLD if active else 0)
                gray = self.attr(247) if 'C' not in self.flags and curses.COLORS >= 256 else curses.A_DIM
                date = time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M',time.localtime(self.timestamp(e)))
                self.put(row,1,date,gray | curses.A_REVERSE)
                perm = format(e.mode & 0o7777,'o').rjust(4)
                if e.link:
                    sz = '@'
                elif stat.S_ISFIFO(e.mode):
                    sz = '|'
                elif stat.S_ISSOCK(e.mode):
                    sz = '='
                elif stat.S_ISBLK(e.mode):
                    sz = 'b'
                elif stat.S_ISCHR(e.mode):
                    sz = 'c'
                else:
                    sz = human(e.du if c.du else e.stat.st_size)
                self.put(row,17,perm+' '+sz.rjust(8)+' ',gray)
                cursor = 31
            if not self.jump:
                self.put(row,cursor-1,'+' if selected else ' ',color | curses.A_BOLD if selected else 0)
            name = printable(e.name)
            avail = max(0,self.cols-cursor-2-len(e.suffix))
            name = clip(name,avail)
            self.put(row,cursor,name,self.entry_attr(e,active))
            suffixattr = self.current_color() if ('C' in self.flags and e.directory) else 0
            self.put(row,cursor+width(name),e.suffix,suffixattr)
        if c.top + page < len(self.entries):
            self.put(self.rows-2,0,'v')
        if self.filter_edit:
            mode = self.filter_mode + ' [/], ' + ('ic' if self.ignorecase else 'noic') + ' [:]'
            if c.hidden:
                mode = 'H  '+mode
            self.put(self.rows-2,self.cols-width(mode),mode,color)
            marker = '\\' if self.filter_mode == 'reg' else '/'
            self.put(self.rows-1,0,marker+self.filter_text,color)
            self.cursor_at = (self.rows-1,min(self.cols-1,width(marker+self.filter_text)))
        elif self.prompt:
            p = self.prompt
            self.put(self.rows-1,0,p['label']+p.get('text',''),color)
            self.cursor_at = (self.rows-1,min(self.cols-1,width(p['label']+p.get('text','')[:p.get('pos',0)])))
        elif self.message is not None:
            self.put(self.rows-1,0,self.message,color)
            self.cursor_at = (min(self.rows-2,c.index-c.top+2),0)
        else:
            x=0
            for s,rev in self.status_parts():
                self.put(self.rows-1,x,s,color | (curses.A_REVERSE if rev else 0))
                x+=width(s)
            self.cursor_at = (min(self.rows-2,c.index-c.top+2),0)
        if self.overlay:
            self.draw_overlay()
        else:
            try:
                curses.curs_set(1 if self.prompt and self.prompt['kind']=='text' or self.filter_edit else 0)
                self.win.move(*self.cursor_at)
            except curses.error:
                pass
        self.win.refresh()

    def move(self, amount, absolute=False):
        if not self.entries:
            return
        self.message = None
        if absolute:
            self.ctx.index = max(0,min(amount,len(self.entries)-1))
        else:
            n = self.ctx.index+amount
            if n >= len(self.entries):
                n = len(self.entries)-1 if 'R' in self.flags or abs(amount)>1 else 0
            elif n < 0:
                n = 0 if 'R' in self.flags or abs(amount)>1 else len(self.entries)-1
            self.ctx.index = n
        self.ctx.name = self.entry().name
        self.adjust_top()
        self.send_fifo()

    def change_dir(self, path, focus='', filtering=None):
        path = os.path.realpath(os.path.expanduser(path))
        if not os.path.isdir(path) or not os.access(path,os.R_OK|os.X_OK):
            self.message = 'chdir failed'
            return
        c = self.ctx
        c.prev,c.path = c.path,path
        c.filters = []
        c.lastfilters = []
        c.index,c.top=0,0
        c.name=focus
        self.entries=[]
        self.filter_text=''
        self.filter_edit = self.navi if filtering is None else filtering
        self.range_start=None
        self.message=None
        try: os.chdir(path)
        except OSError: pass
        self.scan(keep=False,name=focus)
        if 'x' in self.flags:
            sys.stdout.write('\033]0;nnn: '+path+'\007')
            sys.stdout.flush()
        self.send_fifo()

    def parent(self):
        old=self.ctx.path
        parent=os.path.dirname(old)
        if parent!=old:
            self.change_dir(parent,os.path.basename(old))

    def switch(self, number, new=False):
        if number == self.current:
            return
        old = self.ctx
        self.ctx.name = self.entry().name if self.entry() else ''
        if self.contexts[number] is None:
            self.contexts[number]=Context(old.path,self.flags)
            c=self.contexts[number]
            for name in ('detail','hidden','sort','reverse','version','time_type','du'):
                setattr(c,name,getattr(old,name))
        self.current=number
        self.entries=[]
        self.filter_edit=self.navi
        self.filter_text=''
        self.message=None
        self.range_start=None
        try: os.chdir(self.ctx.path)
        except OSError: pass
        self.scan(keep=False,name=self.ctx.name)

    def cycle(self, backwards=False):
        step=-1 if backwards else 1
        n=(self.current+step)%8
        self.switch(n)

    def sorting(self, key, reload=True):
        c=self.ctx
        if key=='r':
            c.reverse=not c.reverse
        elif key=='v':
            c.version=not c.version
        elif key=='c':
            c.reverse=False;c.sort='';c.version=False;c.du=''
        elif key in ('s','t','e'):
            c.sort='' if c.sort==key else key
            c.reverse=False;c.du=''
        elif key in ('a','d'):
            c.du='' if c.du==key else key
            if c.du:c.detail=True
            c.sort='';c.reverse=False
        if reload:self.scan()

    def menu(self, label, callback):
        self.message=None
        self.prompt={'kind':'menu','label':label,'cb':callback}

    def ask(self, label, callback, text='', pos=None):
        self.message=None
        self.prompt={'kind':'text','label':label,'cb':callback,'text':text,'pos':len(text) if pos is None else pos}

    def confirm(self,label,callback):
        self.menu(label,lambda k: callback(k in ('y','Y')))

    def process_prompt(self,key):
        p=self.prompt
        if p['kind']=='menu':
            self.prompt=None
            p['cb'](key)
            return
        if key in ('\x1b','\x03'):
            self.prompt=None
            p['cb'](None)
            return
        if key in ('\n','\r',curses.KEY_ENTER):
            self.prompt=None
            p['cb'](p['text'])
            return
        text,pos=p['text'],p['pos']
        if key in ('\x7f','\b',curses.KEY_BACKSPACE):
            if pos:text=text[:pos-1]+text[pos:];pos-=1
        elif key==curses.KEY_DC:
            text=text[:pos]+text[pos+1:]
        elif key in (curses.KEY_LEFT,'\x02'):
            pos=max(0,pos-1)
        elif key in (curses.KEY_RIGHT,'\x06'):
            pos=min(len(text),pos+1)
        elif key in (curses.KEY_HOME,'\x01'):
            pos=0
        elif key in (curses.KEY_END,'\x05'):
            pos=len(text)
        elif key=='\x15':
            text=text[pos:];pos=0
        elif key=='\x0b':
            text=text[:pos]
        elif key=='\x17':
            prefix=text[:pos].rstrip()
            n=len(prefix)
            while n and not prefix[n-1].isspace():n-=1
            text=text[:n]+text[pos:];pos=n
        elif key=='\t':
            base=os.path.expanduser(text)
            parent,stem=os.path.split(base)
            try:
                choices=[n for n in os.listdir(parent or self.ctx.path) if n.startswith(stem)]
                if choices:
                    expanded=os.path.commonprefix(choices)
                    if len(choices)==1 and os.path.isdir(os.path.join(parent or self.ctx.path,expanded)):expanded+='/'
                    text=os.path.join(parent,expanded) if parent else expanded
                    pos=len(text)
            except OSError:pass
        elif isinstance(key,str) and key.isprintable():
            text=text[:pos]+key+text[pos:];pos+=len(key)
        p['text'],p['pos']=text,pos

    def start_filter(self):
        self.filter_edit=True
        self.filter_text=''
        self.message=None
        self.filter_base=list(self.entries)

    def finish_filter(self):
        if self.filter_text:
            self.ctx.filters.append((self.filter_text,self.filter_mode,self.ignorecase))
        self.filter_edit=False
        self.filter_text=''
        self.filter_base=[]
        self.ctx.name=self.entry().name if self.entry() else ''

    def filter_key(self,key):
        if key=='\x1b':
            self.finish_filter()
            return
        if key in (curses.KEY_UP,curses.KEY_DOWN,curses.KEY_LEFT,curses.KEY_RIGHT,curses.KEY_NPAGE,curses.KEY_PPAGE,curses.KEY_HOME,curses.KEY_END,'\n','\r','\t','\x0e','\x0c','\x15','\x04','\x01','\x05','\x06','\x0f','\x12','\x10','\x16','\x17','\x18','\x07','\x11'):
            self.finish_filter()
            self.process_key(key)
            return
        if key in ('\x7f','\b',curses.KEY_BACKSPACE):
            if self.filter_text:self.filter_text=self.filter_text[:-1]
            else:
                self.finish_filter()
                self.parent()
                return
        elif key=='/':
            self.filter_mode={'str':'fzy','fzy':'reg','reg':'str'}[self.filter_mode]
        elif key==':' and not self.filter_text:
            self.ignorecase=not self.ignorecase
        elif isinstance(key,str) and key.isprintable():
            self.filter_text+=key
        else:return
        base=self.apply_filters(self.all_entries,self.ctx.filters)
        self.entries=self.apply_filters(base,[(self.filter_text,self.filter_mode,self.ignorecase)])
        self.ctx.index=0;self.ctx.top=0
        if len(self.entries)==1 and self.entries[0].directory and self.filter_text and 'A' not in self.flags:
            self.change_dir(self.entries[0].path)

    def toggle_filter(self):
        c=self.ctx
        if c.filters:
            c.lastfilters,c.filters=c.filters,[]
        elif c.lastfilters:
            c.filters,c.lastfilters=c.lastfilters,[]
        self.scan()

    def write_selection(self):
        try:
            if self.selected:
                fd=os.open(self.selection_file,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_TRUNC,0o600)
                with os.fdopen(fd,'wb') as f:f.write(b'\0'.join(os.fsencode(p) for p in self.selected))
            else:
                try:os.unlink(self.selection_file)
                except FileNotFoundError:pass
        except OSError:pass

    def import_selection(self):
        if self.selected:return
        try:
            data=open(self.selection_file,'rb').read()
            self.selected=[os.fsdecode(p) for p in data.split(b'\0') if p]
        except OSError:pass

    def select(self):
        e=self.entry()
        if not e:return
        self.range_start=None
        if e.path in self.selected:self.selected.remove(e.path)
        else:self.selected.append(e.path)
        self.write_selection()
        if not self.noadvance and self.ctx.index<len(self.entries)-1:self.move(1)

    def range_select(self):
        if not self.entry():return
        if self.range_start is None:
            self.selected=[]
            self.range_start=self.ctx.index
        else:
            if self.range_start!=self.ctx.index:
                lo,hi=sorted((self.range_start,self.ctx.index))
                for e in self.entries[lo:hi+1]:
                    if e.path not in self.selected:self.selected.append(e.path)
            self.range_start=None
        self.write_selection()

    def select_all(self,invert=False):
        for e in self.entries:
            if invert and e.path in self.selected:self.selected.remove(e.path)
            elif e.path not in self.selected:self.selected.append(e.path)
        self.range_start=None
        self.write_selection()

    def quit(self,code=0,all_contexts=False,pick=False):
        if pick and self.picker and self.entry():
            if self.entry().path not in self.selected:self.selected.append(self.entry().path)
            self.write_selection()
            code=0
        if not all_contexts:
            active=[i for i,c in enumerate(self.contexts) if c and i!=self.current]
            if active:
                n=max((i for i in active if i<self.current),default=active[-1])
                old=self.current
                self.switch(n)
                self.contexts[old]=None
                return
        if all_contexts and sum(c is not None for c in self.contexts)>1 and 'Q' not in self.flags:
            self.confirm('Quit all contexts?',lambda yes:self.stop(code) if yes else None)
        else:self.stop(code)

    def stop(self,code):
        self.running=False
        self.result=code

    def create_menu(self):
        self.menu("['f'ile]/'d'ir/'s'ym/'h'ard?",lambda key:self.create_name(key if key in 'fdsh' else 'f') if isinstance(key,str) and key in ('f','d','s','h','\r','\n') else None)

    def create_name(self,kind,text=''):
        self.ask('[path/]name: ',lambda name:self.create(kind,name),text)

    def create(self,kind,name,overwrite=False):
        if not name:return
        path=os.path.abspath(os.path.expanduser(os.path.join(self.ctx.path,name)))
        if os.path.lexists(path) and not overwrite:
            self.confirm('overwrite?',lambda y:self.create(kind,name,True) if y else None)
            return
        try:
            if kind=='d':
                os.makedirs(path,mode=0o777,exist_ok=True)
            else:
                os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path),mode=0o777,exist_ok=True)
                if kind=='f':
                    fd=os.open(path,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_TRUNC,0o600)
                    os.close(fd)
                elif kind in ('s','h'):
                    e=self.entry()
                    if not e:return
                    if overwrite and os.path.lexists(path):os.unlink(path)
                    if kind=='s':os.symlink(e.path,path)
                    else:os.link(e.path,path)
            focus=os.path.relpath(path,self.ctx.path).split('/')[0]
            self.scan(name=focus)
        except OSError as e:self.message=e.strerror

    def rename(self):
        e=self.entry()
        if not e:return
        self.ask('',lambda n:self.rename_to(e,n),e.name)

    def rename_to(self,e,name):
        if not name:return
        if name==e.name:
            self.ask('copy [path/]name: ',lambda n:self.duplicate(e,n),e.name)
            return
        dest=os.path.abspath(os.path.join(self.ctx.path,os.path.expanduser(name)))
        if os.path.lexists(dest):
            self.confirm('overwrite?',lambda y:self.do_rename(e,dest) if y else None)
        else:self.do_rename(e,dest)

    def do_rename(self,e,dest):
        try:
            os.rename(e.path,dest)
            if e.path in self.selected:
                self.selected[self.selected.index(e.path)]=dest
                self.write_selection()
            self.scan(name=os.path.relpath(dest,self.ctx.path).split('/')[0])
        except OSError as err:self.message=err.strerror

    def duplicate(self,e,name):
        if not name:return
        dest=os.path.abspath(os.path.join(self.ctx.path,os.path.expanduser(name)))
        if dest==e.path:return
        try:
            os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(dest),exist_ok=True)
            self.copy_path(e.path,dest)
            self.scan(name=os.path.relpath(dest,self.ctx.path).split('/')[0])
        except OSError as err:self.message=err.strerror

    def copy_path(self,src,dest):
        if os.path.islink(src):
            if os.path.lexists(dest):os.unlink(dest)
            os.symlink(os.readlink(src),dest)
            try:shutil.copystat(src,dest,follow_symlinks=False)
            except OSError:pass
        elif os.path.isdir(src):
            shutil.copytree(src,dest,symlinks=True,dirs_exist_ok=True)
        else:shutil.copy2(src,dest)

    def choose_targets(self,cb):
        if self.selected:
            if 'u' in self.flags:cb(list(self.selected))
            else:
                self.menu("'c'urrent/'s'el?",lambda k:cb(list(self.selected)) if k=='s' else cb([self.entry().path]) if k=='c' and self.entry() else None)
        elif self.entry():cb([self.entry().path])

    def delete(self,force=False):
        self.choose_targets(lambda paths:self.delete_prompt(paths,force))

    def delete_prompt(self,paths,force):
        if not paths:return
        label="rm -rf '"+os.path.basename(paths[0])+"'?" if len(paths)==1 else 'rm -rf selected?'
        self.confirm(label,lambda yes:self.do_delete(paths) if yes else None)

    def do_delete(self,paths):
        for path in paths:
            try:
                if os.path.isdir(path) and not os.path.islink(path):shutil.rmtree(path)
                else:os.unlink(path)
            except OSError as e:self.message=e.strerror
            if path in self.selected:self.selected.remove(path)
        self.write_selection()
        self.scan()

    def transfer(self,move=False):
        self.import_selection()
        if not self.selected:
            self.message='0 selected';return
        targets=list(self.selected)
        def do_next(i):
            if i>=len(targets):
                self.selected=[];self.write_selection();self.scan();return
            src=targets[i]
            dest=os.path.join(self.ctx.path,os.path.basename(src))
            if os.path.abspath(src)==os.path.abspath(dest):
                self.message='failed!';return
            def perform(yes=True):
                if yes:
                    try:
                        if move:shutil.move(src,dest)
                        else:self.copy_path(src,dest)
                    except OSError as e:self.message=e.strerror
                do_next(i+1)
            if os.path.lexists(dest):self.confirm('overwrite?',perform)
            else:perform()
        do_next(0)

    def copy_as(self):
        self.import_selection()
        if not self.selected:self.message='0 selected';return
        self.menu("'c'p / 'm'v as?",lambda k:self.ask('[path/]name: ',lambda n:self.transfer_as(n,k=='m')) if k in ('c','m') else None)

    def transfer_as(self,name,move):
        if not name:return
        if len(self.selected)==1:
            src=self.selected[0]
            dest=os.path.join(self.ctx.path,os.path.expanduser(name))
            try:
                if move:shutil.move(src,dest)
                else:self.copy_path(src,dest)
                self.selected=[];self.write_selection();self.scan(name=os.path.basename(dest))
            except OSError as e:self.message=e.strerror

    def bookmark(self):
        self.ask('name: ',self.save_bookmark,os.path.basename(self.ctx.path) or '/')

    def save_bookmark(self,name):
        if not name:self.message='cancelled';return
        dest=os.path.join(self.config,'bookmarks',name)
        try:
            os.symlink(self.ctx.path,dest)
            self.message=dest
        except OSError as e:self.message=e.strerror

    def bookmarks(self):
        if self.bms:
            self.menu('keys: '+' '.join(self.bms),lambda k:self.change_dir(self.bms[k]) if k in self.bms else None)
        else:self.change_dir(os.path.join(self.config,'bookmarks'),filtering=True)

    def session_menu(self):
        self.menu("'s'ave/'l'oad/'r'estore?",lambda k:self.ask('session name: ',self.save_session if k=='s' else self.load_session) if k in ('s','l') else self.load_session('@') if k=='r' else None)

    def save_session(self,name):
        if not name:return
        data={'current':self.current,'contexts':[vars(c) if c else None for c in self.contexts]}
        path=os.path.join(self.config,'sessions',name)
        try:
            fd=os.open(path,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_TRUNC,0o600)
            with os.fdopen(fd,'w') as f:json.dump(data,f)
        except OSError:self.message='open failed'

    def load_session(self,name,startup=False):
        if not name:return
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(self.config,'sessions',name)) as f:data=json.load(f)
            arr=[]
            for v in data['contexts']:
                if v:
                    c=Context(v['path'],self.flags);c.__dict__.update(v);arr.append(c)
                else:arr.append(None)
            self.contexts=arr
            self.current=data['current']
            self.entries=[]
            if not startup:self.scan(keep=False,name=self.ctx.name)
        except (OSError,ValueError,KeyError):
            if name!='@':self.message='open failed'

    def send_fifo(self):
        path=os.environ.get('NNN_FIFO')
        if not path or not self.entry():return
        try:
            fd=os.open(path,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_NONBLOCK)
            os.write(fd,os.fsencode(self.entry().path)+b'\n')
            os.close(fd)
        except OSError:pass

    def open_entry(self,enter=False):
        e=self.entry()
        if not e:return
        if e.directory:self.change_dir(e.path);return
        if 'o' in self.flags and not enter:return
        if self.picker:
            if e.path not in self.selected:self.selected.append(e.path)
            self.write_selection();self.quit(all_contexts=True);return
        if self.ctx.path==os.path.join(self.config,'plugins'):
            self.run_plugin_path(e.path);return
        if e.broken:self.message='open failed';return
        if e.suffix=='|' or stat.S_ISSOCK(e.mode):self.message='unsupported file';return
        if self.is_archive(e.name):
            self.menu("'o'pen/'e'xtract/'l'ist/'m'ount?",lambda k:self.archive_open(e,k));return
        opener=os.environ.get('NNN_OPENER')
        if 'e' in self.flags and 'c' not in self.flags:
            try:
                with open(e.path,'rb') as f:data=f.read(1024)
                if b'\0' not in data:self.edit(e.path);return
            except OSError:pass
        if opener:
            cmd=shlex.split(opener)+[e.name]
            self.external(cmd,wait=False,background='c' not in self.flags)
        else:
            opener=shutil.which('xdg-open') or shutil.which('open')
            if opener:self.external([opener,e.name],background=True)
        if self.advance_open:self.move(1)

    def edit(self,path):
        editor=os.environ.get('EDITOR') if 'E' in self.flags else os.environ.get('VISUAL') or os.environ.get('EDITOR')
        editor=editor or 'vi'
        self.external(shlex.split(editor)+[path],wait=False)
        self.scan()

    def external(self,cmd,wait=False,background=False,shell=False):
        env=os.environ.copy()
        env['NNNLVL']=str(atoi(env.get('NNNLVL','0'))+1)
        for i,c in enumerate(self.contexts):
            if c:env['d'+str(i+1)]=c.path
        if background:
            try:subprocess.Popen(cmd,cwd=self.ctx.path,env=env,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,shell=shell,start_new_session=True)
            except OSError:pass
            return 0
        curses.def_prog_mode();curses.endwin()
        try:
            p=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=self.ctx.path,env=env,shell=shell)
            result=p.returncode
        except OSError as e:
            print(e.strerror);result=1
        if wait:
            try:input("\n'Enter' to continue")
            except (EOFError,KeyboardInterrupt):pass
        curses.reset_prog_mode()
        self.win.clearok(True)
        self.scan()
        return result

    def command_prompt(self,kind):
        label={'open':'open with: ','cmd':'>>> ','app':'app: '}[kind]
        def done(command):
            if not command:
                if kind!='open':self.message=''
                return
            if kind=='open':
                e=self.entry()
                if not e:return
                self.external(command+' '+shlex.quote(e.name),wait=False,shell=True)
            elif kind=='cmd':self.external(command,wait=True,shell=True)
            else:self.external(command,background=True,shell=True)
        if 'N' in self.flags:
            self.ask(label,done)
        else:
            curses.def_prog_mode();curses.endwin()
            try:
                import readline
                line=input(label)
            except (EOFError,KeyboardInterrupt):line=''
            curses.reset_prog_mode();self.win.clearok(True)
            done(line)

    def shell(self):
        self.external([os.environ.get('SHELL') or '/bin/sh'],wait=False)

    def plugin_menu(self):
        if self.plugins:
            self.menu('keys: '+' '.join(self.plugins),lambda k:self.run_plugin(k) if k in self.plugins else None)
        else:self.change_dir(os.path.join(self.config,'plugins'),filtering=True)

    def run_plugin(self,key):
        if key not in self.plugins:
            self.message='invalid key';return
        cmd=self.plugins[key]
        if cmd.startswith('!'):
            wait=cmd.endswith('*')
            command=cmd[1:-1] if wait else cmd[1:]
            self.external(command,wait=wait,shell=True)
        else:self.run_plugin_path(os.path.join(self.config,'plugins',cmd))

    def run_plugin_path(self,path):
        e=self.entry()
        self.external([path,e.name if e else '',str(self.current+1)],wait=False)
        self.scan()

    def is_archive(self,name):
        return bool(re.search(r'\.(zip|tar|tgz|tbz2?|txz|gz|bz2|xz|7z|rar)$',name,re.I))

    def archive(self):
        self.choose_targets(lambda paths:self.ask('archive [path/]name: ',lambda n:self.make_archive(paths,n),os.path.basename(paths[0]) if len(paths)==1 else ''))

    def make_archive(self,paths,name):
        if not name:return
        try:
            import tarfile,zipfile
            dest=os.path.join(self.ctx.path,name)
            if name.endswith('.zip'):
                with zipfile.ZipFile(dest,'w',zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
                    for p in paths:
                        if os.path.isdir(p):
                            for root,dirs,files in os.walk(p):
                                for f in files:z.write(os.path.join(root,f),os.path.relpath(os.path.join(root,f),os.path.dirname(p)))
                        else:z.write(p,os.path.basename(p))
            elif self.is_archive(name):
                mode='w:gz' if name.endswith(('.gz','.tgz')) else 'w:bz2' if name.endswith(('.bz2','.tbz')) else 'w:xz' if name.endswith(('.xz','.txz')) else 'w'
                with tarfile.open(dest,mode) as t:
                    for p in paths:t.add(p,arcname=os.path.basename(p))
            else:self.message='unknown format';return
            self.scan(name=name)
        except Exception:self.message='failed!'

    def archive_open(self,e,key):
        if key=='o':
            opener=os.environ.get('NNN_OPENER') or 'xdg-open'
            self.external(shlex.split(opener)+[e.path],background=True)
        elif key=='e':
            try:
                shutil.unpack_archive(e.path,self.ctx.path)
                self.scan()
            except Exception:self.message='failed!'
        elif key=='l':
            if e.name.endswith('.zip'):self.external(['unzip','-l',e.path],wait=True)
            else:self.external(['tar','-tvf',e.path],wait=True)
        elif key=='m':self.message='install archivemount'

    def jump_to(self,text):
        self.jump=False
        if text:
            n=atoi(text)
            self.move(self.ctx.index+n if text.startswith(('+','-')) else n-1,absolute=True)

    def toggle_exec(self):
        e=self.entry()
        if not e or e.directory:return
        try:
            mode=e.mode & 0o7777
            mode=mode & ~0o111 if mode & 0o111 else mode | 0o111
            os.chmod(e.path,mode)
            self.scan()
        except OSError as err:self.message=err.strerror

    def help(self):
        text=KEYHELP+'\nCONTEXTS\n'
        for i,c in enumerate(self.contexts):
            if c:text+=f' {i+1}{"*" if i==self.current else " "} {c.path}\n'
        fs=os.statvfs(self.ctx.path)
        text+='\nVOLUME: avail:'+human(fs.f_bavail*fs.f_frsize)+' used:'+human((fs.f_blocks-fs.f_bfree)*fs.f_frsize)+' size:'+human(fs.f_blocks*fs.f_frsize)+'\n'
        if self.bms:
            text+='\nBOOKMARKS\n'+''.join(' '+k+': '+v+'\n' for k,v in self.bms.items())
        if self.plugins:
            text+='\nPLUGINS\n'+''.join(' '+k+': '+v+'\n' for k,v in self.plugins.items())
        text+='\nSELECTION FILE: '+self.selection_file+'\n\nv5.2\nBSD 2-Clause\nhttps://github.com/jarun/nnn\n'
        fd,path=tempfile.mkstemp(prefix='nnn')
        try:
            with os.fdopen(fd,'w') as f:f.write(text)
            pager=os.environ.get('PAGER')
            if pager:self.external(shlex.split(pager)+[path])
            else:self.external(['cat',path])
        finally:
            try:os.unlink(path)
            except OSError:pass

    def show_stats(self):
        if not self.entry():return
        self.overlay='stats';self.overlay_offset=0;self.overlay_x=0
        self.refresh_stats()

    def refresh_stats(self):
        e=self.entry()
        if not e:return
        try:
            out=subprocess.run(['stat',e.path],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout
        except OSError:out=''
        self.stats_lines=out.splitlines()

    def draw_overlay(self):
        h=max(6,self.rows-4);w=max(10,self.cols*3//4)
        y=2;x=(self.cols-w)//2
        title=f' {self.ctx.index+1}/{len(self.entries)} {self.entry().name} '
        footer='/ESC:close  arrows:scroll  n/j:next  p/k:prev'
        self.put(y,x,'l'+'q'*(w-2)+'k')
        self.put(y,x+2,clip(title,w-4))
        for row in range(1,h-1):
            self.put(y+row,x,'x'+' '*(w-2)+'x')
        self.put(y+h-1,x,'m'+'q'*(w-2)+'j')
        self.put(y+h-1,x+2,clip(footer,w-4))
        for i,line in enumerate(self.stats_lines[self.overlay_offset:self.overlay_offset+h-4]):
            self.put(y+2+i,x+1,clip(line[self.overlay_x:],w-4))
        if any(len(s)>w-4 for s in self.stats_lines):self.put(y+h-2,x+w-3,'>')
        try:curses.curs_set(0)
        except curses.error:pass

    def overlay_key(self,key):
        if key in ('\x1b','/','q','\n','\r'):
            self.overlay=None
        elif key in ('n','j','p','k'):
            self.move(1 if key in ('n','j') else -1);self.refresh_stats()
        elif key==curses.KEY_DOWN:self.overlay_offset+=1
        elif key==curses.KEY_UP:self.overlay_offset=max(0,self.overlay_offset-1)
        elif key==curses.KEY_RIGHT:self.overlay_x+=1
        elif key==curses.KEY_LEFT:self.overlay_x=max(0,self.overlay_x-1)

    def export_list(self):
        self.ask('[path/]name: ',self.export_to)

    def export_to(self,name):
        if not name:return
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(self.ctx.path,name),'w') as f:
                for e in self.entries:f.write(e.name+'\n')
            self.scan(name=name)
        except OSError as e:self.message=e.strerror

    def process_key(self,key):
        if self.overlay:self.overlay_key(key);return
        if self.prompt:self.process_prompt(key);return
        if self.filter_edit:self.filter_key(key);return
        if key==curses.KEY_RESIZE:return
        oldmessage=self.message
        if key not in ('\x1b',):self.message=None
        if key in ('j',curses.KEY_DOWN):self.move(1)
        elif key in ('k',curses.KEY_UP):self.move(-1)
        elif key in ('h',curses.KEY_LEFT,'\x7f',curses.KEY_BACKSPACE):self.parent()
        elif key in ('l',curses.KEY_RIGHT):self.open_entry()
        elif key in ('\r','\n',curses.KEY_ENTER):self.open_entry(enter=True)
        elif key in ('g','\x01',curses.KEY_HOME):self.move(0,absolute=True)
        elif key in ('G','\x05',curses.KEY_END):self.move(len(self.entries)-1,absolute=True)
        elif key in (curses.KEY_PPAGE,'\x15'):self.move(-max(1,self.rows-4))
        elif key in (curses.KEY_NPAGE,'\x04'):self.move(max(1,self.rows-4))
        elif key=="'":
            self.move(next((i for i,e in enumerate(self.entries) if not e.directory),0),absolute=True)
        elif key=='~':self.change_dir(self.home)
        elif key=='`':self.change_dir('/')
        elif key=='@':self.change_dir(self.start_path)
        elif key=='-':
            if self.ctx.prev:self.change_dir(self.ctx.prev)
        elif key=='\t':self.cycle()
        elif key==curses.KEY_BTAB:self.cycle(True)
        elif isinstance(key,str) and key in '12345678':self.switch(int(key)-1)
        elif key=='q':self.quit()
        elif key=='Q':self.quit(code=0 if self.picker else 1,all_contexts=True,pick=True)
        elif key in ('\x11','\x07'):
            if key=='\x07':self.write_cd=True
            self.quit(all_contexts=True)
        elif key=='\x1b':
            now=time.monotonic()
            if now-self.lastesc<.6:self.quit(all_contexts=True)
            else:self.send_fifo()
            self.lastesc=now
        elif key=='.':
            self.ctx.hidden=not self.ctx.hidden;self.ctx.filters=[];self.scan()
        elif key=='d':self.ctx.detail=not self.ctx.detail
        elif key=='/':self.start_filter()
        elif key=='\x0e':
            self.navi=not self.navi
            if self.navi:self.start_filter()
        elif key=='\x0c':self.toggle_filter()
        elif key in ('t','\x14'):self.menu("'a'u/'d'u/'e'xt/'r'ev/'s'z/'t'm/'v'er/'c'lr/'^T'?",self.sort_menu)
        elif key=='T':self.menu("'a'ccess / 'c'hange / 'm'od ["+self.ctx.time_type+']',self.set_time)
        elif key in (' ','+'):self.select()
        elif key=='a':self.select_all()
        elif key=='A':self.select_all(True)
        elif key=='m':self.range_select()
        elif key=='n':self.create_menu()
        elif key=='\x12':self.rename()
        elif key in ('x','X','\x18'):self.delete(key=='X')
        elif key in ('p','\x10'):self.transfer()
        elif key in ('v','\x16'):self.transfer(True)
        elif key in ('w','\x17'):self.copy_as()
        elif key=='*':self.toggle_exec()
        elif key in ('B',','):self.bookmark()
        elif key in ('b','\x1f'):self.bookmarks()
        elif key=='s':self.session_menu()
        elif key=='J':
            if self.entry():self.jump=True;self.ask('jump (+n/-n/n): ',self.jump_to)
        elif key=='S':
            total=sum(e.stat.st_blocks*512 for e in self.entries if e.path in self.selected)
            self.message=human(total)
        elif key=='e':
            if self.entry():self.edit(self.entry().path)
        elif key in ('f','\x06'):self.show_stats()
        elif key in ('o','\x0f'):
            if self.entry():self.command_prompt('open')
        elif key==']':self.command_prompt('cmd')
        elif key=='=':self.command_prompt('app')
        elif key in ('!','\x1d'):self.shell()
        elif key==';':self.plugin_menu()
        elif key=='?':self.help()
        elif key=='c':self.message='install sshfs/rclone'
        elif key=='u':self.message='not a mount point'
        elif key=='z':self.archive()
        elif key=='>':self.export_list()
        elif key=='r':self.batch_rename()
        elif key=='E':self.edit_selection()
        elif key=='\x19':
            for i in list(range(self.ctx.index+1,len(self.entries)))+list(range(self.ctx.index)):
                if time.time()-self.timestamp(self.entries[i])<86400:self.move(i,absolute=True);break
        elif key=='0':
            locker=os.environ.get('NNN_LOCKER') or 'vlock'
            if shutil.which(shlex.split(locker)[0]):self.external(shlex.split(locker))
        else:self.message=oldmessage

    def set_time(self,key):
        if key in ('a','c','m'):
            self.ctx.time_type=key
            self.scan()

    def sort_menu(self,key):
        if key=='\x14':
            self.ask('order: ',lambda x:self.sorting(x[0]) if x else None)
        elif isinstance(key,str) and key in 'aders tvc'.replace(' ',''):self.sorting(key)

    def batch_rename(self):
        paths=list(self.selected) if self.selected else [e.path for e in self.entries]
        if not paths:return
        fd,p=tempfile.mkstemp(prefix='nnn')
        try:
            with os.fdopen(fd,'w') as f:f.write('\n'.join(os.path.basename(x) for x in paths)+'\n')
            self.edit(p)
            names=open(p).read().splitlines()
            for src,name in zip(paths,names):
                if name and name!=os.path.basename(src):
                    try:os.rename(src,os.path.join(os.path.dirname(src),name))
                    except OSError:pass
            self.scan()
        finally:os.unlink(p)

    def edit_selection(self):
        self.import_selection()
        if not self.selected:return
        fd,p=tempfile.mkstemp(prefix='nnn')
        try:
            with os.fdopen(fd,'w') as f:f.write('\n'.join(self.selected)+'\n')
            self.edit(p)
            self.selected=[x for x in open(p).read().splitlines() if x]
            self.write_selection()
        finally:os.unlink(p)

    def run(self,win):
        self.win=win
        self.rows,self.cols=win.getmaxyx()
        try:
            curses.noecho();curses.cbreak();win.keypad(True)
            curses.start_color();curses.use_default_colors()
        except curses.error:pass
        try:curses.set_escdelay(25)
        except AttributeError:pass
        self.load_colors()
        win.timeout(100)
        self.scan(keep=False,name=self.ctx.name)
        if self.start_new:self.create_name('f',self.start_new)
        elif self.navi:self.start_filter()
        if self.pending_plugin and len(self.pending_plugin)==1:
            self.run_plugin(self.pending_plugin)
        if 'x' in self.flags:
            sys.stdout.write('\033]0;nnn: '+self.ctx.path+'\007');sys.stdout.flush()
        self.send_fifo()
        while self.running:
            self.draw()
            try:key=win.get_wch()
            except curses.error:
                if not self.prompt and not self.filter_edit and time.monotonic()-self.last_scan>1:
                    try:stamp=os.stat(self.ctx.path).st_mtime_ns
                    except OSError:stamp=0
                    if stamp!=self.dir_stamp:self.scan()
                continue
            self.process_key(key)
        if 'S' in self.flags:self.save_session('@')
        if self.write_cd and os.environ.get('NNN_TMPFILE'):
            try:
                with open(os.environ['NNN_TMPFILE'],'w') as f:f.write('cd '+shlex.quote(self.ctx.path)+'\n')
            except OSError:pass
        if self.picker and self.selected:
            sep=b'\0' if '0' in self.flags else b'\n'
            data=sep.join(os.fsencode(p) for p in self.selected)+sep
            if self.picker=='-':self.picker_out=data
            else:
                try:
                    with open(self.picker,'wb') as f:f.write(data)
                except OSError:pass
        return self.result


def main():
    try:locale.setlocale(locale.LC_ALL,'')
    except locale.Error:pass
    flags,values,paths=options(sys.argv)
    picker=values.get('p')
    if picker and picker!='-':
        path=os.path.abspath(os.path.expanduser(picker))
        values['p']=path
        try:
            fd=os.open(path,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT,0o600);os.close(fd)
            os.unlink(path)
        except OSError as e:
            sys.stderr.write('9618: '+e.strerror+'\n');return 1
    # A non-terminal input is interpreted as a stream of paths, not keystrokes.
    streamed=None
    stdout_fd=None
    if not os.isatty(0):
        streamed=sys.stdin.buffer.read()
        records=[os.fsdecode(s) for s in re.split(b'[\x00\n]',streamed) if s]
        if not records:sys.stderr.write('0 entries\n');sys.stderr.flush()
        try:
            fd=os.open('/dev/tty',os.O_RDWR)
            os.dup2(fd,0)
            if not os.isatty(1):
                stdout_fd=os.dup(1);os.dup2(fd,1)
            os.close(fd)
        except OSError:
            # Without a controlling terminal the file manager waits to be attached.
            while True:time.sleep(60)
    if picker=='-' and not os.isatty(1) and stdout_fd is None:
        try:
            fd=os.open('/dev/tty',os.O_WRONLY)
            stdout_fd=os.dup(1);os.dup2(fd,1);os.close(fd)
        except OSError:pass
    try:
        manager=Manager(flags,values,paths)
        result=curses.wrapper(manager.run)
        if stdout_fd is not None:
            os.dup2(stdout_fd,1);os.close(stdout_fd)
        if manager.picker_out:
            sys.stdout.buffer.write(manager.picker_out);sys.stdout.buffer.flush()
        return result
    except KeyboardInterrupt:return 1
    except curses.error:
        term=os.environ.get('TERM')
        sys.stderr.write('Error opening terminal: '+(term or 'unknown')+'.\n')
        return 1


if __name__=='__main__':
    raise SystemExit(main())

def atoi(value):
    m = re.match(r'^[ \t]*([+-]?\d+)', str(value))
    return int(m.group(1)) if m else 0


def options(argv):
    flags = set()
    values = {}
    paths = []
    valid = 'aAbBcCdDeEfFgHiJJKlNnoOpPQrRsStTuUVxz0h'
    valid = 'aAbBcCdDeEfFgHiJKlNnopPQrRsStTuUVxz0h'
    argopts = 'bFlpPstT'
    valid += 'HS'
    # Environment options are individual letters, not shell words.
    def apply(c, value=None, env=False):
        if c not in valid:
            if not env:
                sys.stderr.write(f"{argv[0]}: invalid option -- '{c}'\n")
            sys.stdout.write(HELP)
            raise SystemExit(1)
        if c == 'h':
            sys.stdout.write(HELP)
            raise SystemExit(0)
        if c == 'V':
            print('5.2')
            raise SystemExit(0)
        if c == 'K':
            raise SystemExit(0)
        if c in argopts:
            if value is not None:
                values[c] = value
        else:
            flags.add(c)
    for c in os.environ.get('NNN_OPTS', ''):
        apply(c, env=True)
    i = 1
    stop = False
    while i < len(argv):
        word = argv[i]
        if word == '--' and not stop:
            stop = True
        elif word.startswith('-') and len(word) > 1 and not stop:
            j = 1
            while j < len(word):
                c = word[j]
                value = None
                if c in argopts:
                    if j + 1 < len(word):
                        value = word[j+1:]
                        j = len(word)
                    elif i + 1 < len(argv):
                        i += 1
                        value = argv[i]
                    else:
                        sys.stderr.write(f"{argv[0]}: option requires an argument -- '{c}'\n")
                        sys.stdout.write(HELP)
                        raise SystemExit(1)
                    apply(c, value)
                    break
                apply(c)
                j += 1
        else:
            paths.append(word)
        i += 1
    if atoi(values.get('F', '0')) not in (0, 1):
        raise SystemExit(1)
    return flags, values, paths


def human(size):
    size = max(0, int(size))
    if size < 1024:
        return str(size) + 'B'
    unit = 0
    scale = 1
    while size >= scale * 1024 and unit < 5:
        unit += 1
        scale *= 1024
    # Display up to three decimal places, without insignificant zeroes.
    fraction = (size % scale) * 1000 // scale
    tail = ('.' + str(fraction).zfill(3).rstrip('0')) if fraction else ''
    return str(size // scale) + tail + 'BKM GTP'.replace(' ', '')[unit]


def width(s):
    total = 0
    for c in s:
        if unicodedata.combining(c):
            continue
        total += 2 if unicodedata.east_asian_width(c) in ('W', 'F') else 1
    return total


def clip(s, n):
    out = ''
    used = 0
    for c in s:
        w = 0 if unicodedata.combining(c) else (2 if unicodedata.east_asian_width(c) in ('W', 'F') else 1)
        if used + w > n:
            break
        out += c
        used += w
    return out


def printable(s):
    return ''.join(c if c.isprintable() else '?' for c in s)


def fileext(name):
    pos = name.rfind('.')
    return name[pos:] if pos >= 0 else ''


def read_map(var):
    data = os.environ.get(var, '')
    mapping = {}
    if not data:
        return mapping
    for pair in data.split(';'):
        if not pair:
            continue
        if len(pair) < 3 or pair[1] != ':':
            sys.stderr.write(var + '\n')
            raise SystemExit(1)
        mapping[pair[0]] = pair[2:]
    return mapping


class Entry:
    def __init__(self, path, name, du=False):
        self.name = name
        self.path = os.path.join(path, name)
        self.lstat = os.lstat(self.path)
        self.link = stat.S_ISLNK(self.lstat.st_mode)
        self.broken = False
        try:
            self.stat = os.stat(self.path) if self.link else self.lstat
        except OSError:
            self.stat = self.lstat
            self.broken = True
        self.directory = stat.S_ISDIR(self.stat.st_mode)
        self.mode = self.lstat.st_mode if du and self.link else self.stat.st_mode
        self.size = self.stat.st_size if stat.S_ISREG(self.stat.st_mode) and not self.link else 0
        self.du = 0
        self.files = 1
        if self.directory:
            self.suffix = '/'
        elif self.link:
            self.suffix = '@'
        elif stat.S_ISFIFO(self.mode):
            self.suffix = '|'
        elif stat.S_ISSOCK(self.mode):
            self.suffix = '='
        elif stat.S_ISREG(self.mode) and self.mode & 0o111:
            self.suffix = '*'
        else:
            self.suffix = ''


class Context:
    def __init__(self, path, flags):

        self.navi = 'n' in flags
        self.filter_mode = 'reg' if 'g' in flags else 'fzy' if 'z' in flags else 'str'
        self.ignorecase = True

        self.filter_text = ''
        self.filter_base = []
        self.entries = []
        self.all_entries = []
        self.prompt = None
        self.message = None
        self.jump = False
        self.overlay = None
        self.running = True
        self.result = 0
        self.lastesc = 0
        self.sort_disk_total = 0
        self.sort_disk_count = 0
        self.current = 0
        self.colors = {}
        self.ctxcolors = []
        self.last_scan = 0
        self.start_new = None
        self.pending_plugin = values.get('P')

        if os.path.isdir(path):

        elif os.path.lexists(path):

            path = os.path.realpath(os.path.dirname(path))
        else:
            if paths and paths[0].endswith('/'):

                    path = self.cwd
            else:

                self.start_new = initial_name
                path = os.path.dirname(path)

                    os.makedirs(path, exist_ok=True)

                sys.stderr.write('invalid key\n')
                raise SystemExit(1)
            path = os.path.realpath(os.path.expanduser(self.bms[key]))

            if not os.path.isdir(path):

        self.start_path = path

        self.contexts = [None] * 8
        self.contexts[0] = Context(path, flags)

        self.overlay_x = 0
        self.external_screen = False
        if values.get('T'):
